definition: T1-25 is a certified-core plus innovation-reserve design philosophy. The +25 label is a lifecycle/service/innovation planning heuristic and scenario point, never a blanket engineering, legal, ecological, energy or financial multiplier.

rules.rule: 100 percent of applicable law/code/approval basis remains controlling; no 1.25 compliance multiplier.
Certified conventional load path first; advanced topology/material concepts remain secondary until independently proven.
rules.validation: FEA, hand checks, materials/connections and RPEQ review

rules.rule: Use about 25 percent spare pathway/cabinet/conduit capacity as a planning scenario where lifecycle economics justify it; do not automatically oversize every active device.
rules.validation: growth, maintenance, fault and lifecycle analysis

rules.rule: Operational security uses proven supply/PV/BIPV/storage; allocate bounded interfaces/test areas to Solar Hull/Paint and Free Flow R&D.
Safe capture/first-flush/overflow/reuse first; 25 percent is only a storage/distribution sensitivity case unless the catchment model supports it.
High ecological integration outside critical operational envelopes; use E0 protection, E1 restoration, E2 engineered living and E3 experimental zones.
rules.validation: site ecology, custodial/cultural, fire, biosecurity, hydrology and monitoring review

rules.rule: Harmonisation means measured optimisation for stated receptor/human/structural/ecological objectives; active resonance remains isolated R&D.
rules.validation: spectrum, insertion loss, reverberation, modal response and receptor monitoring

rules.rule: Sensors/twins improve observability and maintenance; they do not replace certification or human engineering authority.
rules.validation: calibration, stale-data/failure injection, cyber recovery and access tests

rules.rule: Advanced skins/sensors/ecology/digital layers should be replaceable without destructive primary-structure intervention where practical.
Civic-industrial, clean, optimistic and advanced visual language; approximate 75/25 durable-to-experimental expression is a render/design heuristic only.
COIN-first provenance/governance; economic/value layers are separately gated and disabled by default.
Affected assets expose compatible NORMAL, PRE_LAUNCH, LAUNCH_LOCKOUT, ABORT and POST_EVENT_INSPECTION states; no autonomous launch/aviation authority.
rules.validation: state-transition tests, QRA/HAZID, drills, failover and inspection criteria

non_negotiable_constraints: Hard safety/compliance constraints cannot be traded for aesthetics, energy, ecology or innovation score.
The +25 concept cannot create a code factor, resistance factor, load factor, ecological offset, energy-output claim, financial right or regulatory exemption.
Innovation promotion requires attributable evidence, a versioned decision owner and a revalidation trigger.
Drive remains the canonical approved knowledge/control surface for this programme.
